atoms.name: Greedy choice and exchange argument
atoms.one_line: Commit to a locally best choice; correctness needs a proof, counterexamples are common.

atoms.name: Huffman coding
atoms.one_line: Merge the two smallest; cost = sum of merged weights; prefix-free codes.

atoms.name: Interval scheduling and partitioning
atoms.one_line: Earliest finish for selection; rooms = peak overlap for partitioning.

atoms.name: Scheduling rules
atoms.one_line: Profit-first with latest free slot; shortest job first; w/p ratio.

atoms.name: Knapsack: fractional vs 0/1
atoms.one_line: Ratio greedy is optimal only when items can be split.

atoms.name: Coin change
atoms.one_line: Greedy works for canonical systems such as 1, 5, 10, 25 but not 1, 3, 4.

atoms.name: Paradigm identification
atoms.one_line: Kruskal, Prim, Dijkstra, Huffman are greedy; Floyd-Warshall is DP; Merge sort is divide and conquer.
